fusions.name: On the Scent
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Baying Chorus
fusions.desc: Howls through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and leaving them [Marked] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Whistled Familiar
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, whistles up a hound of arcana that fights beside you for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fetch
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 mana. Once every 4 seconds.
